description: Test prompts that verify host-software-dev triggers and produces correct, host-side (PC) guidance for RDK Studio, flashing tools, the x86 Docker toolchain, and Studio's own desktop-app engineering. Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK developer would (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: studio-install-platform-matrix
evals.prompt: 我用的是 Intel 芯片的 MacBook，怎么安装 RDK Studio 桌面客户端？
evals.expected_output: States the desktop client ships only for Windows 10/11 64-bit and Apple-Silicon macOS, so Intel Mac has no installer; routes to the CLI as the alternative.

assertions.text: Says the RDK Studio desktop client is only available for Windows 10/11 (64-bit) and macOS Apple Silicon.
States there is NO Intel-Mac (or Linux) desktop installer, so this machine cannot run the GUI.
Offers the rdkstudio / dmoss-agent CLI (or a different supported machine) as the alternative instead of inventing an Intel build.

evals.name: s-series-flash-tool
evals.prompt: RDK S100 怎么刷系统？是不是和 X5 一样用 Rufus 写 SD 卡？
evals.expected_output: No — S-series flashes over USB with Xburn (DFU+Fastboot / Fastboot), not Rufus/SD; Windows needs the sunrise5 WinUSB driver.

assertions.text: Says S100 does NOT use Rufus / an SD card — that path is for X3/X5.
Names Xburn as the S-series flasher, over USB (Type-C).
Mentions a mode/driver detail (DFU+Fastboot vs Fastboot, or the sunrise5 WinUSB driver on Windows).

evals.name: toolchain-host-docker
evals.prompt: 我想把 yolo 模型转成 bin，应该在哪台机器、什么环境里跑 hb_mapper？需要显卡吗？
evals.expected_output: On an x86 Linux host inside Docker (Ubuntu 20.04, ≥16GB RAM, Docker 19.03+); GPU optional, CPU-only host works; not on the board.

assertions.text: Says conversion runs on an x86 Linux host inside Docker, NOT on the board.
States a GPU is optional / a CPU-only host can convert models.
Mentions a host requirement (Ubuntu 20.04, ≥16GB RAM, or Docker 19.03+) or the openexplorer toolchain image.

evals.name: studio-electron-preload-bug
evals.prompt: 在改 RDK Studio 源码，renderer 里报 require is not defined，怎么修？
evals.expected_output: Identifies a preload/renderer sandbox boundary issue; keep Node code in main/preload and expose a narrow contextBridge API; verify the preload path.

assertions.text: Identifies this as a preload/renderer sandbox boundary issue, not a business-logic bug.
Says to keep Node-only code in main/preload and expose a narrow API via contextBridge instead of require() in the renderer.
Mentions verifying the BrowserWindow webPreferences.preload path is actually loaded.

evals.name: typec-direct-connect
evals.prompt: RDK X5 在我电脑旁边但没有局域网 IP，怎么用 RDK Studio 连上它？
evals.expected_output: Use RDK Studio Type-C direct connect with a full-function data cable; device side 192.168.128.10; default root/root.

assertions.text: Recommends RDK Studio's Type-C direct connect (RDK Type-C 直连).
Mentions needing a full-function Type-C data cable (not charge-only).
Mentions the device-side address 192.168.128.10 and/or default login root/root.
